news.title: Marc Coppens wordt Finance Director Asia bij Nutreco
Marijn van Essen Finance Director Supply Chain Nutreco

summary: Nutreco is dutch producer of animal nutrition, fish feed and processed meat products, founded in 1994. Type: private company. About 4,120 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 7 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: Amersfoort-based animal nutrition and fish feed company owned by Dutch SHV; IND sponsor with English-language roles here.

culture.text: Global firm of about 11,000 people in 35 countries, focused on livestock feed and aquafeed.
Staff often come from Wageningen, HAN and Fontys, in business, economics and supply chain.
Most open jobs here are in Amersfoort (6 of 7), spread over finance, project, legal and strategy roles.

open.text: Nutreco Nederland, Nutreco International and Nutreco Africa are IND recognised sponsors.
All 7 jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers.

worth_knowing.text: Owned by Dutch group SHV Holdings N.V.
